thread:
Alex W: Hey team — escalated from Jen (acme corp). Private EU deploy hitting intermittent 502s when calling /v1/generate, and collector uploads to S3 failing with 403s. Customer can repro. Need debug bundle + repro steps.

Jen (customer): seeing ~20% of requests 502 over last hour. Request ID examples: req-20260317-7a3f, req-20260317-8b4c. Uploads to our S3 endpoint failing with "AccessDenied".

Maria S: thanks. Can you paste one full request ID header and the curl you used? Also which collector version on the private node?

Jen (customer): here's curl we used (sanitized):

Jen (customer): ```
curl -i -X POST https://private-api.eu.acme.example/v1/generate \  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \  -H "X-Request-ID: req-20260317-7a3f" \  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-small","prompt":"Summarize ...","max_tokens":150}'
```

Samir K: good. Can you run the collector bundle command on the host and upload? Steps: 

Samir K: ```
sudo /opt/redwood/collector/bin/collector generate-bundle \  --output /tmp/rwd-debug-req-7a3f.tgz \  --include-logs /var/log/redwood/*.log \  --include-config /etc/redwood/** \  --redact /etc/redwood/redact.conf
```

Samir K: If upload to our presign fails, scp the bundle to a jump host I provide.

Oscar R: for repro: try this curl against the private control plane (will show auth headers and response):

Oscar R: ```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \  -H "X-Request-ID: req-20260317-8b4c" \  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-small","prompt":"test"}' \  https://private-api.eu.acme.example/v1/generate
```

Oscar R: also share the collector.log snippet around the 403 timeframe. Example grep:

Oscar R: ```
sudo journalctl -u redwood-collector --since "2026-03-17 09:00" | grep -i "upload" -A5 -B2
```

deploy-bot: collector deployed v1.12.4 to private-node-3 at 2026-03-17T09:05Z

Maria S: copy of redaction config we expect (customer please confirm you have similar):

Maria S: ```
# /etc/redwood/redact.conf
- paths:
  - /etc/redwood/secrets.yaml
  - /var/log/redwood/*access.log
  - /var/log/redwood/*auth.log
  rules:
  - remove_keys: ["api_key", "authorization"]
  - mask_regex: "Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9\-_.]+"
```

Alex W: if redaction mismatch occurs, collector may leave real tokens. We need to check bundle size and run local redact check:

Alex W: ```
/opt/redwood/collector/bin/collector redact-check /tmp/rwd-debug-req-7a3f.tgz
```

Samir K: Upload presign flow (internal):

Samir K: ```
rwd presign upload --file /tmp/rwd-debug-req-7a3f.tgz --team acme --expires 1h
# returns URL -> curl -T /tmp/rwd-debug-req-7a3f.tgz "<PRESIGNED_URL>"
```

Jen (customer): presign gave 403 when we attempted upload via curl. Same error from collector.

Maria S: ok please run scp fallback: I'll DM jump host details. Also paste output of `ls -lh /tmp/rwd-debug-req-7a3f.tgz` and `sha256sum`.

Jen (customer): size 24M, sha256 is abcdef123456...

Oscar R: also include kernel dmesg and docker logs for the inference container around times:

Oscar R: ```
sudo dmesg | tail -n 100 > /tmp/dmesg-clip.txt
sudo docker logs --since "2026-03-17T08:50" redwood-runner > /tmp/runner.log
```

Samir K: noted. I'll try to repro in staging with same request ids. If upload 403 persists, likely S3 policy on customer's side or collector role creds. We'll check collector sts assume role logs.

Alex W: next steps: Jen to produce bundle or scp it; Samir to run initial redaction check; Oscar to run repro curl and inspect collector logs; Maria to verify presign permissions. Keeping thread here for audit.

Jen (customer): starting collector now, will update when uploaded :thumbsup:
